title: 回滚时保留稳定副本的比例

standard.summary: 回滚后的权重 = 稳定副本 × 该比例 + 当前权重 × (1 − 该比例)。0.70 表示 70% 稳定 + 30% 当前。默认 0.70。
standard.effect: 调低 = 回滚更轻，保留更多本轮学到的内容；调到 1.0 相当于整轮回退到上一份副本。取值被夹在 0~1。
standard.whenToUse: 回滚后掉点太狠、loss 反复重走老路时调低。
standard.avoidWhen: 把 1.0 当默认——整轮丢弃通常比插值更伤，除非确认本轮完全跑飞。

standard_en.summary: Weights after a rollback = stable copy x this ratio + current weights x (1 - this ratio). 0.70 means 70% stable plus 30% current. Default 0.70.
standard_en.effect: Lower means a gentler rollback that keeps more of what this epoch learned; 1.0 is a full revert to the previous copy. The value is clamped into 0-1.
standard_en.whenToUse: Lower it when a rollback drops quality too hard and loss keeps re-walking the same ground.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not treat 1.0 as the default -- discarding a whole epoch usually hurts more than interpolating, unless the epoch clearly diverged.

advanced.principle: 构造 guard 时把 keep_ratio 夹进 [0.0, 1.0]；回滚时对每个可训练张量做 stable * keep + current * (1 - keep) 的原地插值，因此这是「部分回滚」，不是加载旧 state_dict。
advanced.intervention: 回滚发生的那一次 epoch 边界，逐张量插值。
advanced.expectedImpact: 只影响回滚当轮的权重，后续训练的起点随之变化。
advanced.tradeoffs: 插值按张量逐元素做，不做范数归一化；对已经爆炸的权重，混合后仍可能偏大，必要时配合更低的 lr 或更低的 clip 阈值。

advanced_en.principle: keep_ratio is clamped into [0.0, 1.0] when the guard is built; on a rollback every trainable tensor is interpolated in place as stable * keep + current * (1 - keep), so this is a partial rollback rather than loading an old state_dict.
advanced_en.intervention: At the single epoch boundary where the rollback fires, tensor by tensor.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Only the rollback epoch's weights change; the starting point of later training moves with it.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The interpolation is element-wise with no norm renormalisation, so already-exploded weights can stay large after blending; pair it with a lower lr or clip threshold when needed.
